name: neobrutalism-alerts
title: Alerts
description: Neobrutalism-style alert components built with Tailwind CSS. Featuring thick borders, hard shadows, and bold colors. Perfect for displaying important messages, notifications, and feedback with a retro, high-contrast look.
useWhen: Showing a prominent success, error, or informational message in a high-contrast interface.
Drawing immediate attention to the outcome of a completed user action.
avoidWhen: Showing a transient background update — use a toast instead.
Communicating many unrelated messages at the same time.
responsiveBehavior: Alert content wraps while preserving icon and message alignment. The bordered panel spans its container on narrow screens rather than overflowing.
accessibility: Use role="alert" for urgent errors and role="status" for non-urgent updates.
Do not communicate alert severity through color alone.
